constraints.machine: 24 GB shared Mac; one heavy process at a time per agent, each < 1 GB RSS (this task) / < 1.5 GB (DESIGN_STEP2); never /tmp; kill what you start; no Wolfram
constraints.engines: engines A and B run every item independently and do not read each other's step2 outputs before the comparison phase; both may import their own Step-1 code
constraints.rules: Euclidean; UV boundary for every singular and anomalous coefficient; the standard Costello transfer endpoint T is allowed (P(eps,T) = int_eps^T (Q^GF (x) 1) K_t dt, QP(eps,T) = K_eps - K_T, effective action and observables at scale T, [C07]); every core quantity (counterterms, obstructions, finite counterterms, local representatives L_1(O), components Q_1, S_1, D_1, K_1, P_1, M_1, R_1) must be T-independent, T must not enter the core theory, and T -> infinity is taken wherever it is safe (design prop:o-Tsafe); no masses, no position cutoff R, no other IR regulator in any definition (R only as a diagnostic); no dimensional regularisation in any role; exact results (rational, possibly log 2, log 3, pi^2, Li_2 values) by exact integration or >= 40-digit numerics + integer relation on an explicit basis confirmed by a second evaluation; unit = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) written out in reports
constraints.reporting: every reported formula index-free AND in Weinberg-Srednicki two-component form (R1); the user's Q_1,S_1,D_1,K_1 are one-loop components, the spinor parameters are xi in Sigma, eta in Sigma^* (never the manuscript's Q_1 in Sigma, Q_2 in Sigma^*) (R3 name clash)
constraints.reduction_rule: reduce outputs only by full s-exact cochains s chi with chi = (chi^(0), chi^(1), chi^(2)) carried along at arities 0, 1, 2 before applying r_xi (r_xi(s chi) = Q_0^xi r_xi(chi)); never drop a (Q+{I,-})-exact term at a single arity; record every reduction as the triple (design rem:o-exact)

rank_one_supercharge.index_free: xi = u (x) w in S_+ (x) W, u in S_+, w in W nonzero; auxiliary u' in S_+ with u'^a u_a = 1, n in W^* with n_i w^i = 1

graph_class_reference.arity_two_xi_xi: arity-one marked vertices with one further S^(1)(xi); arity-zero marked vertices with two further S^(1)(xi); S^(2)(xi,xi) only inside the marked vertices of prop:o-arity2 (never as a separate vertex next to an arity-zero marked vertex)

large_distance_decay_of_floating_inserti.K_{v1}: |y|^-4, sphere average -3 b_k/(16 pi^4 R^4) (with propagator factors 2 and -1 removed): logarithmic; at finite T: log T with coefficient 3/(8 pi^2) times the cut tree
large_distance_decay_of_floating_inserti.P-edge pair (two floating odd insertions: superficial IR degree g1+g2-1 in R^8 for one orientation (g = 0 for Sigma, 1 for Sigma^*); the orientation sum lowers it by one
large_distance_decay_of_floating_inserti.P-edge pair Sigma x Sigma^*: degree 0 per orientation, cancels in the orientation sum (degree -1): converges (step2/qa/design_revision/truncation_and_orientation_check.json)
large_distance_decay_of_floating_inserti.P-edge pair Sigma^* x Sigma^*: degree 1 per orientation; orientation sum leaves a log with S^3-averaged symbol 6i v1.(f0 g1 - f1 g0), v1 = Gamma(eta1,eta2)|_V; O(eps) in defect graphs, O(1) in O[T]^(2) and W^(2); zero pointwise for v1 = 0
large_distance_decay_of_floating_inserti.finite T: every component of P(eps,T) and its derivatives bounded by the T = infinity tails uniformly in T and Gaussian for |y|^2 >> T: all graphs finite
